senses.definition: (chiefly Canada, US, Australia, New Zealand) A recorded sequence of images displayed on a screen at a rate sufficiently fast to create the appearance of motion; a film.
examples: He is watching a crime-thriller movie.

senses.definition: (usually in the plural, chiefly Canada, US, Australia, New Zealand) A cinema; a movie theatre.
(informal, figuratively) Any event, especially one that is unpleasant or tiresome.
examples: Don't worry; this isn't the first time I've been through this movie.
